title: Someday - Kids
description: All kids dream of a bright future, their someday. We want to help ensure that all kids have a chance to realize their ‘someday’, and through the RBC Kids Pledge we’re working to make that happen. To learn more about what we're doing to help kids realize their potential, visit http://www.rbc.com/kids
